title: 第21章 暗教复仇第22章 王座争议
lines: 北境旧军道铺着潮湿碎石，车辙从山脚一路拖向曜都外环。
商旅停在路边，卖水的木桶旁挂着传讯牌。有人把“持晶者”三个字刻进蜡板，又迅速塞回袖中。还有驿站小厮蹲在马槽后，冲同伴比划洛晖压跪商会精英的动作，手比得太大，差点把马吓到。
洛晖路过驿站，抬手敲了敲木牌。
“写慢点，别把我写成三头六臂。真长三头，吃饭都费钱。”
小厮手一抖，蜡板掉进水桶。
绮兰把银盒扣紧，契约镜面里封着停战协议、破阵锥黑粉、商会金印拓影。
“传言跑得比马快。你若不管，天黑前会有人说你在奥尔山称王。”
洛晖扯了下嘴角。
“我是不喜欢被人捧杀，不是不喜欢别人闭嘴。”
绮兰看了他一眼，继续在镜面外层加封。
绮雯走在右侧阴影边，暗影囊贴着腰侧，里面灰烬星纹碎屑不时顶起一小块。她掌心绷带重新缠过，蓝色净火从缝里冒出，又被她按回暗星核心。
护腕内，显曜给的回传针忽然嗡地一震。
蓝色短讯弹开。
“皇城外围补给线遇袭。废弃粮塔段。星痕碎片被夺。”
洛晖停步。
第二条短讯紧跟着亮起。
“袭击者为暗影教余党。灰烬星纹借学院补给箱缝隙聚合，定位来源疑似第九次学院突袭残片样本。”
绮兰手指停在契约镜面上。
“学院样本转运路线被摸到了。”
绮雯抬手按住暗影囊，囊口灰纹剧烈翻动。
“残波还新。碎片没进深坛。”
第三条短讯亮起。
“运输车队携带试炼后回收星痕碎片、星纹修复药剂、议事厅临时护卫装备。铁卫巡逻岗提前撤离半个时辰。”
洛晖把短讯按灭。
“长夏这手干净得像刚洗过锅。”
绮兰收起银盒。
“他不用出手。暗教杀人，补给线失守，议事厅里自然有人说你私夺星痕招来复仇。铁卫再伸手接管城外补给，顺理成章。”
洛晖转身，看向废弃粮塔方向升起的暗紫火柱。
“那就让顺理成章断腿。”
绮兰拉住马缰。
“我先回曜都外环。奥尔山证据必须进绮氏密探网，商会那群人抢不到星痕，会先抢叙事。”
绮雯把斗篷拉紧。
“我带你走暗影短道。暗教残波在三更前还能追。”
绮兰侧身拦住她。
“让暗教少主带路追暗教，你倒会选位置。刀架在背上，也省得抽刀。”
绮雯抬手压住刀柄。
“贵族密探也能把人卖进棺材。你家棺材还镶银边。”
洛晖一掌拍在运输车厢上。
“吵架排队。”
两人同时看向他。
洛晖指向绮兰。
“你带协议镜面回外环，联络绮氏密探，稳住补给调度。别让商会先把锅扣我头上。”
又指向绮雯。
content_en:
The old military road in the north is paved with wet gravel, with ruts dragging from the foot of the mountain all the way to the outer ring of Yaodu.
The businessman was parked on the roadside, and a communication sign was hung next to the wooden barrel selling water. Someone carved the words "Crystal Holder" into the wax tablet and quickly stuffed it back into his sleeve. There was also a boy at the inn squatting behind the manger, gesticulating at his companions like Luo Hui kneeling down the elites of the Chamber of Commerce. His hands were so big that he almost frightened the horse.
Luo Hui passed by the inn and raised his hand to knock on the wooden sign.
"Write slowly, don't write me as three heads and six arms. If I have three heads, it will cost me money to eat."
The boy shook his hand and the wax plate fell into the bucket.
Qilan fastened the silver box tightly, and the contract mirror contained the armistice agreement, the formation-breaking black powder, and the gold seal of the Chamber of Commerce.
"It is rumored that you can run faster than a horse. If you don't care, someone will say that you are king in Orshan before dark."
Luo Hui twitched the corners of his mouth.
"I don't like being praised, it's not that I don't like others to shut up."
Qilan glanced at him and continued to seal the outer layer of the mirror.
Qiwen walked beside the shadow on the right side, with the shadow sac close to her waist, with a small piece of ash star pattern debris inside from time to time. The bandage on her palm was wrapped again, blue pure fire emerged from the gap, and she pressed it back to the core of the Dark Star.
Inside the wrist guard, the return needle given by Xian Yao suddenly buzzed.
A blue text message popped up.
"The supply line outside the imperial city was attacked. The grain tower section was abandoned. The star trace fragments were taken away."
Luo Hui stopped.
The second text message lights up immediately.
"The attackers are the remnants of the Shadow Cult. The ash star pattern was gathered through the gap in the academy's supply box, and the source is suspected to be a sample of the fragments from the ninth academy raid."
Qilan's fingers rested on the contract mirror.
"The college's sample transfer route has been touched."
Qiwen raised her hand to hold the shadow bag, and the gray lines on the bag's mouth turned violently.
"The residual wave is still new. The fragments have not entered the deep altar."
The third text message lights up.
"The transport convoy carries star mark fragments recovered after the trial, star mark repair medicine, and temporary security equipment for the conference hall. The Iron Guard patrol post was evacuated half an hour in advance."
Luo Hui clicked out the text message.
"Chang Xia's hands are as clean as if they had just washed the pot."
Qilan put away the silver box.
"He doesn't need to take action. The secret cult has killed people and the supply line has been lost. Naturally, some people in the meeting hall said that you secretly stole the star marks to attract revenge. It is natural for the Iron Guard to reach out and take over the supplies outside the city."
Luo Hui turned around and looked at the dark purple fire pillar rising in the direction of the abandoned grain tower.
"Then let's break the leg as a matter of course."
Qilan pulled the reins of the horse.
"I'll go back to the outer ring of Yaodu first. Olshan's evidence must go into the Qi's secret agent network. If the people from the Chamber of Commerce can't grab Xinghen, they will grab the narrative first."
Qiwen pulled her cloak tight.
"I'll take you through the short shadow path. The Dark Cult Zanbo can still catch up before the third watch."
Qilan stepped aside to stop her.
"Let the Young Master of the Dark Cult lead the way to pursue the Dark Cult, and you will be able to choose your position. With the knife on your back, you won't have to draw it."
Qiwen raised her hand to press the handle of the knife.
"Noble spies can also sell people into coffins. Your coffins are even rimmed with silver."
Luo Hui slapped the transport carriage with his palm.
"Quarrel queue."
The two looked at him at the same time.
Luo Hui pointed at Qilan.
"Take the protocol mirror back to the outer ring, contact Qi's secret agent, and stabilize the supply schedule. Don't let the Chamber of Commerce blame me first."
Then he pointed at Qiwen.
title_en: Chapter 21 The Revenge of the Dark Cult Chapter 22 The Throne Controversy
